evidence_chain.link: The presence of nasal discharge is a common symptom of bacterial sinusitis.
The presence of nasal discharge does not necessarily indicate anatomical obstruction, such as foreign body obstruction.

ranked_facts.why: The presence of nasal discharge with worsening pain supports the diagnosis of bacterial sinusitis (B1), while the absence of signs of anatomical obstruction, such as foreign body obstruction (B2), makes it less likely.

evidence_chain.link: The presence of purulent nasal discharge is a common symptom of bacterial sinusitis.
